title: Finemap (SuSiE) pipeline parameters
description: Shared genofile creation, sumstats harmonization/munging, and PolyFun SuSiE finemapping (no functional priors) for the 18 GWAS'd dogCD phenotypes (3 factors + 14 items + SIZE).

qc6_plink_dir.description: 3_Merging_filtering's published plink/ output directory (holds both QC5 and QC6 files; DA_MERGED_GENCOVE_AXIOM_QC5.{bed,bim,fam} are used here).

size_sumstats_dir.description: 1_mlma-loco's published sumstats/size/ subdirectory (SIZE_sumstats.txt) — kept separate from mlma_sumstats_dir per 1_mlma-loco's own SIZE-vs-factors publish split.

size_fam.description: Deposited raw data file, not built by any pipeline: SIZE_DA_MERGED_GENCOVE_AXIOM_QC6.fam.

stuck_fam.description: Deposited raw data file, not built by any pipeline: STUCK_DA_MERGED_GENCOVE_AXIOM_QC6.fam. Used only as a sample-inclusion mask for the shared genofile, not as an analysed phenotype.

allfam_fam.description: Deposited raw data file, not built by any pipeline: ALLFAM_DA_MERGED_GENCOVE_AXIOM_QC6.fam.
